reviewNotes: Reviewed all 140 speech keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages58.json. Contextual topic/contrast は, には, では and とは rendered わ; object を rendered お; directional 献立へ, 一口へ, 塩鮭へ, 一汁三菜へ, 副菜へ and どこへ rendered え. Preserved lexical ごはん, はごたえ, はぎれ, はたらき, はいぜん, はいち, はいぶん, へらす and へんか. Checked いちじゅうさんさい, しゅさい, ふくさい, ふくふくさい, こうのもの, かんみ, にひん, さんぴん, さんさら, ふたさら, ぐだくさん, びりょうえいようそ, ちょうふく and のうたん against source readings. Loanwords rendered in hiragana retaining long-vowel marks. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
